text.text_excerpt: Fairly small space so it can get crowded during their Thursday evening [free] tastings but at other times you'll always get great customer service and have access to a bunch of fantastic quality food & drink. The cheese & salumi selection is limited but great which will often bring me into the store for cocktail hour fare (Keife & Co. isn't nearly as large as St. James but all the cheeses are great, the service is MUCH better, and prices are listed so you know the cost before you buy) . Keife & Co. are off to an auspicious start. What the store may lack in size (it's only a little bigger than my living room/dining room area) it makes up in quality. The owners are careful to only stock quality items and their love of wine and spirits shows without coming off as being snobby. There's also a small meat and cheese counter, because a bottle of wine is not complete without them. The staff is very friendly and knowledgeable and will help you find just what you're looking for even if you don't know yourself.

Awesome. So great to find a store that sells liqueurs and liqours that appeal to those who are looking to find something beyond the typical "top shelf" of New Orleans bar rooms. I took home a bottle of pine nut liqueur, some Swedish punch (which is just about the tastiest of all Viking drinks) and some craft bitters. The staff was friendly and excited to let me taste different bitters and invited to to their tasting nights. In a city filled with booze, it's nice to finally have a liquor store. They also sell cheese and meats.
